concept.th-compile-time.def: The phase before a program runs, when the compiler translates the source and checks the rules.
concept.th-run-time.def: The phase when the built program actually executes, one instruction at a time.
concept.th-build-error.def: A rule-breaking mistake the compiler catches at compile time, before anything runs.
concept.th-runtime-platform.def: A platform that finishes and runs a portable build on each machine, like .NET.
concept.th-cross-compile.def: Building on one machine but aiming the compiler at a different target - another CPU or operating system.
